activities.name: Galápagos wildlife
activities.note: the islands have no closed season and the animals do not migrate away — what changes is which species is doing what

windows.reason: one of the best months for marine wildlife: the Humboldt Current brings nutrient-rich cold water that draws whale sharks, hammerheads and dolphins, and migratory birds gather

activities.name: Humpback whales off the Pacific coast
activities.note: the whales are in Antarctic waters the rest of the year

windows.reason: humpbacks migrate from their Antarctic feeding grounds to mate and give birth off the coast between June and September; Puerto López and Machalilla National Park are the places to watch
